const CASES: &[Case] = &[
    Case { name: "first", source: include_str!("fixtures/first.ts") },
    Case { name: "second", source: include_str!("fixtures/second.ts") },
];

#[test]
#[ignore = "pinned TypeScript"]
fn pinned() {
    let cases = [
        ("quoted", "a string containing ] and },", true),
        ("raw", r###"#[test]
#[ignore]
fn text_is_not_a_test() {}
] } " quoted"###, false),
    ];
    for module in ["es2022", "commonjs"] {
        consume(module);
    }
}

mod nested {
    #[ignore]
    #[test]
    fn second() {}
}

fn nested_macros() {
    assert_eq!(outer!({"source": include_str!("fixtures/in_macro.ts")}), true);
    let _literal = "include_str!(\"not_a_fixture.ts\")";
}

#[path = "support/custom.rs"]
mod external;

const MODES: &[(Target, Option<bool>)] = &[(Target::Es2022, None), (Target::Es2020, Some(false))];

fn programs() -> Vec<Program> {
    vec![Program { name: "first-program" }, Program { name: "second-program" }]
}

fn controls() {
    accepts("const value = 1;", options, true);
    accepts("const value: number = 'bad';", options, false);
}
